what: The Shankaracharya math in Kolhapur, formerly part of the Sankeshvar math, broke away c. 50 years before (i.e. c. 1909) and is now the Karvir Pitha; the building is occupied by the Sankaracharya of Sankeshvar
earlier_ref: 1886: Deshasths' high priest is Shankaracharya at Sankeshvar; Sankeshvar Svami's maths in Kolhapur city; no Karvir pitha named
quote: The building is occupied by Sankaracarya of Sankesvar. Although formerly it was a part of the Sankesvar Math, the link was broken about 50 years ago and now the Kolhapur math is known as Karvir Pitha.
